notes.title: Notification of follow-up update for the game
notes.notes:
According to the players feedback, modify some  content of the game.
1, modify the movement mode to teleport in the story mode
2, modify the way of holding  shield in the story mode
3, modify the display of  intelligence when it is picked up 
4, cancel the weapons - dagger

Increased Weapons:
1, increase the Micro submachine gun     Mac-10
2, increase the revolver

The above content is being developed, the next version update will gradually modify or increase the relevant game content. I hope you continue to focus on the game, we will optimize the game accordingly to your feedback.
